QuestInfo.name: Strange World: Verne Mine Revisited
QuestInfo.0: You finally get to read Kaiser's report on Maple World.
QuestInfo.1: Kaiser's report on Maple World is sure to have valuable information. You should read the whole thing.
QuestInfo.2: The more of Kaiser's report you read, the worse you felt. Transcendent side effects, Gerand Darmoor's recent activity... What if all of this was planned?

0.msg: It would be a good idea to gather your thoughts and read through the report.
